text: Yıldız Holding, pladis's (and so McVitie's) ultimate parent, was founded by brothers Sabri and Asım Ülker, who began the business in 1944, and was consolidated under the Yıldız Holding name on 13 November 1989. Ülker family members continue to sit on its Board of Directors today.

source.name: Yıldız Holding: 'Our Heritage' (Corporate)
source.quote: On November 13, 1989, our companies are consolidated under the name Yıldız Holding.
